en-US.description:
Its Adventure Time by Mason is your ultimate off-road companion for discovering and navigating trails. Whether you're into overlanding, 4x4 adventures, or trail riding, this app has everything you need.

KEY FEATURES:
- Live GPS tracking with speed, altitude, and distance
- Rally-style navigator with audio callouts for turns and hazards
- Community-driven trail database with user-submitted routes
- Offline maps for areas without cell service
- AI Recovery Scan - snap a photo of your stuck situation and get recovery advice
- SOS emergency sharing with location tracking
- Trail difficulty ratings and safety information
- Save and share your adventures with friends

PERFECT FOR:
- Overlanding enthusiasts
- 4x4 off-roaders
- Trail riders and hikers
- Adventure seekers
- Emergency preparedness

Download now and start your next adventure!

Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://thegoodadventuretime.web.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://thegoodadventuretime.web.app/privacy-policy
en-US.promoText: Discover amazing trails and navigate with confidence! Live GPS tracking, navigator, AI recovery assistance, and community trails. Your off-road adventure starts here!
en-US.title: Its Adventure Time
en-US.subtitle: Off-road GPS navigation

review.notes:
This is an off-road navigation and trail tracking app. No login is required to use the basic features. Users can immediately start exploring trails and tracking their adventures.

Key features to test:
- Live GPS tracking and speed display
- Rally navigator with audio callouts
- Community trail database
- AI Recovery Scan feature
- SOS emergency sharing

Business model: The app is free to download. A premium monthly subscription (com.masongallegos.itsadventuretime.premium.monthly.v2) and yearly subscription (com.masongallegos.itsadventuretime.premium.yearly.v2) unlock premium features. The subscriptions are handled through RevenueCat.

The app works offline once trails are downloaded.
No demo account is required.

The paywall and subscription screen now clearly display the App Store Connect product title, subscription length, price, a 'What's included' list, and tappable Terms of Use (EULA) and Privacy Policy links before any purchase button.

A screen recording demonstrating the updated paywall, subscription disclosure, and tappable legal links is attached in the App Review Information section below.
